patch.description:
Full-card replacement producing an immutable new version. Old versions stay intact for
conversations pinned to them. Non-admin edits to a shared character send it back to draft.

post.description: Queues for review only. Nothing is exposed until a moderator approves.

delete.description: Hard delete: messages, turns, jobs cascade. Transient event streams are removed too.

get.description:
Replayable SSE. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID to resume; terminal events are delivered once
per stream position, so a reconnect never yields a second final message.

delete.description: Hard-deletes the account and everything it owns. Ledger rows survive pseudonymized.
